query: WITH candidate_tables AS (SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND (table_name ILIKE '%exercise%' OR table_name ILIKE '%question%' OR table_name ILIKE '%attempt%' OR table_name ILIKE '%answer%' OR table_name ILIKE '%result%') ORDER BY table_name LIMIT 30), columns AS (SELECT c.table_name, string_agg(c.column_name || ':' || c.data_type, ', ' ORDER BY c.ordinal_position) AS definition FROM information_schema.columns c JOIN candidate_tables t ON t.table_name=c.table_name WHERE c.table_schema='public' GROUP BY c.table_name), policies AS (SELECT tablename, string_agg(policyname || ':' || cmd, ', ' ORDER BY policyname) AS definition FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN (SELECT table_name FROM candidate_tables) GROUP BY tablename), active_lessons AS (SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM public.course_subject_offerings o JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id AND s.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.chapters c ON c.subject_offering_id=o.id AND c.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.lessons l ON l.chapter_id=c.id AND l.is_active IS TRUE WHERE o.is_published IS TRUE) SELECT 'table' AS kind, t.table_name AS name, coalesce(c.definition,'') AS details FROM candidate_tables t LEFT JOIN columns c ON c.table_name=t.table_name UNION ALL SELECT 'policy', p.tablename, p.definition FROM policies p UNION ALL SELECT 'active_published_lessons', 'count', count FROM active_lessons ORDER BY kind,name LIMIT 100;
